title: Kystverket WFS layer 'VTS tjenesteområde 2021 versjon 2' (layer_696)
supports: Complete set of statutory VTS service areas (six polygons, each referenced to Sjøtrafikkforskriften §6); none overlaps any B-II/19 TSS in this group (Melkøya area max latitude 71.09N, east of 22.56E; others south of 62.05N)

title: Forskrift om bruk av sjøtrafikksentralenes tjenesteområde og bruk av bestemte farvann (sjøtrafikkforskriften), FOR-2021-02-10-523
date_or_edition: consolidated text, last amended FOR-2026-06-29-1454 (in force 1 July 2026) as reported by the fetch tool; accessed 29 September 2026
supports: §6 lists six VTS service areas (Horten, Brevik, Kvitsøy, Fedje, Kinn, Melkøya); chapter 5 (§§169 to 172) routeing measures in the EEZ with no reporting provision
passage: Horten tjenesteområde, Brevik tjenesteområde, Kvitsøy tjenesteområde, Fedje tjenesteområde, Kinn tjenesteområde, Melkøya tjenesteområde

title: Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) centres (contact page)
supports: Lists the six VTS areas (Horten, Brevik, Kvitsøy, Fedje, Kinn, Melkøya) and separately an NOR VTS information service for Barents SRS and TSS
passage: Information service for Barents SRS and routing schemes (TSS) in Norway - NOR VTS

title: About the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS)
supports: Vardø VTS centre (NOR VTS) monitors risk vessels following the offshore routeing measures; its VTS area task is Melkøya
passage: The centre monitors tankers and other risk vessels that follow the routing measures established outside the Norwegian coast.

title: SN.1/Circ.318, New mandatory ship reporting system 'In the Barents Area (Barents SRS)', annex resolution MSC.348(91)
date_or_edition: 4 December 2012 (MSC.348(91) adopted 28 November 2012; in force 0000 UTC 1 June 2013); accessed 29 September 2026
supports: Barents SRS participation thresholds, geographical boundary (points A to H), reporting to Vardø VTS centre (Norwegian monitoring area)
locator: Annex paras 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1.1 (copy hosted by the Faroese Maritime Authority, fma.fo; text is the IMO circular itself)
passage: All Barents SRS reports must be sent to either Vardø VTS centre or Murmansk VTS centre.

title: Barents Ship Reporting System
supports: Kystverket states the TSS from Vardø to Røst are inside the Barents SRS operational area; reports in Norwegian area go to NOR VTS (Vardø)
passage: The traffic separation systems off the Norwegian coast from Vardø to Røst are within the operational area of Barents SRS.

title: Kystverket WFS layer 'TSS områder' (layer_706), services.kystverket.no
supports: Official polygons of each TSS lane and separation zone; eight clusters named 'Trafikkseparasjonssystemer utenfor norskekysten mellom Vardø og Røst', plus separately named Træna and Halten TSS; used to test inclusion in Barents SRS and VTS areas

title: Resolution MSC.190(79), Mandatory ship reporting system in the Western European PSSA (WETREP)
supports: WETREP northern/eastern limit (58°30'N to 62°N at 000°) lies far west of the Træna and Halten TSS (about 005°E to 007°E); WETREP does not include them

title: Navigation rules (TSS in the Norwegian economic zone)
date_or_edition: undated web page (refers to changes from 1 June 2021); accessed 29 September 2026
supports: Routeing system in the EEZ; applicable ship categories; no reporting obligation stated for the TSS
locator: Section 'Navigation rules in the Norwegian economic zone (TSS)'
passage: Vessels in international traffic that may represent a high environmental risk must follow route measures that take these vessels further off the coast.
